title: Poland's Defense Surge and Fiscal Squeeze Put Europe's Eastern Frontier to… · 05 Sep
keywords: Poland, defense spending, NATO, military budget, inflation, GDP growth, fiscal deficit, EU fiscal rules, European security, rearmament, Polish economy, Donald Tusk
notes: Poland is spending nearly 5% of its economic output on defense, making it the most militarized economy in NATO by that measure, while simultaneously managing sticky inflation and a widening budget deficit. The twin pressures of rearmament and economic management are reshaping daily life for Polish citizens and setting a precedent for how European Union members navigate the post-Ukraine security era. Warsaw's choices in the months ahead will carry consequences well beyond its own borders.
